'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Assassination attempts on Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]
***The [[Security Service of Ukraine]] says that it detained two [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] government protection unit colonels recruited by [[Russia]]'s [[Federal Security Service]] who were planning an assassination of [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] and other top Ukrainian officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-catches-russian-agents-plotting-zelenskiy-assassination-sbu-says-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] launch a missile strike on an [[oil terminal]] in [[Luhansk]], causing a large fire and injuring at least five workers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-forces-hit-oil-depot-russian-held-city-local-leader-says-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]]
***[[Israel Defense Force|Israeli forces]] enter [[Rafah]] in a "limited" operation, taking control of the [[Rafah Border Crossing]] on the [[Egypt–Gaza border]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2024-05-06/ty-article-live/idf-three-soldiers-killed-near-gaza-border/0000018f-4ba4-dcda-abcf-6ba7979b0006 (''Haaretz'')] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-humanitarian-aid-8659eae6e0a7362504f0aa4aa4be53e0 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-take-control-vital-rafah-crossing-gaza-into-egypt-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
***At least 27 people are killed by [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s in Rafah. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/5/7/israels-war-on-gaza-live-israel-blasts-rafah-fate-of-ceasefire-uncertain (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-humanitarian-aid-8659eae6e0a7362504f0aa4aa4be53e0 (AP)] 
*[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
**The death toll from rocket strikes on an [[Internally displaced person|IDP camp]] in [[Goma]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], increases to 18. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-strikes-eastern-congo-camps-rises-18-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Boy Scouts of America]] announces the renaming of the organization to Scouting America on February 8, 2025, in an effort to make girls feel more welcome. [https://apnews.com/article/boy-scouts-new-name-scouting-america-d583f5712680f155b4f6b762128734d3 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornadoes of 2024]]
**[[Tornado outbreak of May 6–10, 2024]]
***A [[FedEx]] warehouse in [[Portage, Michigan|Portage]], [[Michigan]], [[United States]], is destroyed by a tornado. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/2024/05/07/tornado-confirmed-in-michigan/73605562007/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from ongoing heavy flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 90, with more than 150,000 people left homeless. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/brazil-floods-death-toll-rises-90-dozens-still-stranded-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/brazil-floods-leave-150000-homeless-scores-dead-or-missing-2024-05-07/ (Reuters 2)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**[[The Bahamas]] formally recognizes [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] as an independent nation. [https://ewnews.com/the-bahamas-recognizes-palestine-as-a-state-joining-fellow-independent-caricom-members (Eyewitness News Bahamas)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russian undesirable organizations law]]
**[[Russia]] declares [[United States|American]] [[nonprofit organization]] [[Freedom House]] an "undesirable organization", effectively outlawing the group, after accusing the group of "discrediting the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian Army]]" and advocating [[sanctions involving Russia|sanctions against Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-declares-us-ngo-freedom-house-an-undesirable-organisation-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and 21 others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] at a hospital in [[Zhenxiong County]], [[Yunnan]], [[China]]. A suspect has been detained. [https://apnews.com/article/china-hospital-knife-attack-yunnan-a2838f71be28824c251f096b13ded28c (AP)]
*[[TikTok]] and its parent company [[ByteDance]] sue the [[United States government]] over the [[Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act]], alleging that the law is [[Constitution of the United States|unconstitutional]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tiktok-3b4c1fa44c89d4568d26f1c7caf303ec (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses]]
***[[The Netherlands|Dutch]] police end a pro-Palestinian occupation at the [[University of Amsterdam]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dutch-police-end-pro-palestinian-demonstration-amsterdam-university-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Fifth inauguration of Vladimir Putin]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] is inaugurated for a fifth six-year term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-vladimir-putin-sworn-president-fifth-term-2024-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Premiership of John Swinney]]
**The [[Scottish Parliament]] votes to elect [[John Swinney]] as [[First Minister of Scotland]] with 64 votes in favour and seven abstentions from the [[Scottish Greens]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0de2ke9vjdo (BBC News)]
